notes: UGC grid: 5 equal-width columns (flex-[1_0_0], 16px gap), no section heading/eyebrow. Each card = UGC Card / Below / Desktop: a 344px-tall image (caption-below layout) with a circular semi-transparent white badge (rgba(255,255,255,0.85), 999px radius) bottom-right showing a media-type icon — image icon (cards 1,3,4) or play/video icon (cards 2,5). Below the image: caption block with an uppercase handle (Label/Caption text style, foreground_heading) and a quote line (Text/Small, foreground). Bespoke card component (UGC Card / Below / Desktop instances), not a known shared library atom. Single color scheme (Essential roles only, no mode divergence). Outer container 1440px desktop, 40px vertical padding; section frame 1680px. No mobile variant present at this node — desktop only.
